title: Re-scope Console: Essentials-only dashboards, lightweight trace viewer, and cost-summary tile
creator: Aisha Kline
description: Context: The Console observability epic contains a broad set of features (rich dashboards, full distributed traces with flamegraphs, multi-dim cost explorers). Early design and engineering signals indicate that delivering the complete surface in one increment will push the release beyond acceptable timelines and increase risk to runtime invest. Goal: deliver a trimmed, high-value MVP that surfaces essential operational telemetry for teams integrating Redwood inference quickly, while deferring heavier exploratory features to follow-up sprints.
scope_decision_summary: Cut scope to three lightweight features: 1) Essentials dashboard (3 core cards per route), 2) Lightweight trace viewer (single-request trace with span list + links to raw logs), 3) Cost-summary tile (7-day rollup by model and route). Deferred: interactive heatmaps, long-window time-series exploration, full distributed trace flamegraphs, advanced cost drilldowns, and custom card builder. Cuts driven by implementation risk, storage costs, and UX polish effort.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard: Default route-scoped dashboard renders within 300ms on initial load and includes exactly three cards: P95 latency, error rate (5xx %), and request throughput (RPS). Each card supports quick range toggles (1h / 24h / 7d).
Dashboard: Cards are routable — clicking a card filters by route and exposes a link to the lightweight trace viewer for sampled requests.

Trace viewer: For a sampled request_id, the UI displays an ordered list of spans (max 10) with timestamps, duration, span name, and host. Full distributed flamegraph and span waterfall are out of scope for MVP.
Trace viewer: Search by request_id and copy request_id button present. Opening a trace returns within 500ms for typical payloads.
Cost tile: Shows aggregated cost for last 7 days broken down by model and by route (two-row summary). Filter by project/org. Fetch completes <500ms for typical datasets (<=30k requests/day).
Feature gating: All three features must be behind a feature flag (console.observability.essentials) to allow canary rollout and quick rollback.
Telemetry: Emit events for dashboard_open, card_click, trace_open, and cost_tile_open with basic route/model metadata; succeed/fail metrics appear in telemetry dashboard.
Docs: Quickstart doc (one page) and a short GIF walkthrough included; links in console help center must be functional.
Privacy/Security: No raw user payloads displayed in the trace viewer; only metadata/spans and scrubbed identifiers permitted.
notes: 2026-03-09 planning sync: PM, Eng infra, and Design aligned on essentials cut. Engineering flagged two blockers: storage retention for traces and query latency on the cost aggregation endpoint.
Design: Figma frames created for minimal dashboard and compact trace list - Figma link included below. DES review suggested reducing card verbage and using icons only for compactness.
Engineering: ENG prioritized a small trace sampling pipeline (1% sample) to keep storage and query costs predictable for MVP.
Follow-ups: Post-MVP tickets for heatmaps (PM-88001), flamegraph (ENG-21500), and cost-explorer (PM-88102).
decision_log: 2026-03-08: Decision to limit dashboard to three cards — tradeoff favors faster time-to-value over customizability.
2026-03-09: Agree to implement trace sampling at 1% for GA and expose sample rate in UI settings later.
2026-03-11: Cost aggregation implemented server-side as daily rollups to reduce query complexity; supports 7-day window only for MVP.
2026-03-12: Feature flag requirement added after security & SRE review to enable canarying and quick rollback.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Cost aggregation queries could be slow against hot customers. Mitigation: server-side daily rollups + cache for hot routes; fall back to an async refresh path if load is high.
Risk: Trace open latency could exceed SLO under heavy load. Mitigation: enforce 1% sampling and cap returned spans to 10; implement circuit-breaker and surface error message with retry link.
Risk: Users need more granularity than MVP provides. Mitigation: surface 'Request full explorer' CTA that creates a support ticket / feature request linking to paid feature roadmap.
Risk: Unexpected privacy concerns. Mitigation: restrict trace viewer to metadata-only by default and run a short privacy review with Security (contact: Priya Menon).
